sources.finding: Go1.27.3 released2026-10-19 adds crypto/x509 security fixes. Official download metadata and pinned golang1.27.3-bookworm image manifest were verified. Rebuilds retain actual Go binary module metadata.

Preserve PostgreSQL18.6 baseline digest5a5a84b19854a9ffaa54082c166ff4ec27473a361e496e5ea167f298f2da9722 and gosu1.19 source commit. Rebuild gosu withGo1.27.3 and install the exact signed Debian pcre2/OpenSSL fixes identified by actual scans.

Use released2.7.1 source distribution with embedded UI, checksum6da0c07e61d8dfd2ab72ad47cb96691fb7abfecd460a55272545346575c37711. Regenerate vendor tree for x/net0.60.0; stamp numeric semantic version2.7.1, source commit and commit timestamp. Default runtime API/Raft behavior preserved.
Version1.31.6 and multi-platform index digest23fe39e81bde596a918000b3135c0f85dc8bb4c9ea6be274b051143f3e300387 verified; actual vulnerability scan and isolated SMTP/API checks pass.

Latest tested vendor0.37.0 includes Grafana13.2.3, Prometheus3.15.0, Tempo3.1.0, Loki3.7.8, Pyroscope2.4.0, Collector0.162.0 and OBI0.14.0. Scan still fails; preserve every component. Signed catalog plugins are separate release artifacts.

Signature validation verifies executable hashes in vendor manifests. Latest signed PostgreSQL plugin13.0.4 still has5 fixable HIGH findings. No changed trust root or unsigned-plugin setting is authorized.

limitations: Research and private candidate validation do not approve registry publication, default adoption, protected-main merge, deployment or release.
A candidate containing an extracted file truncated by the disk-full incident was rejected despite its clean vulnerability scan. Compatibility remains an independent gate.
